scope: Three five-subtask batches: staged scheduled/async worker composition, durable admission/API adapters, and actual evaluation read composition. These are implemented components, not complete public runtime or release acceptance.

implementation.W1-W5: Actual scoped transport/owner claim/start, shared supervised poller, exact prepared identity binding, whole-batch completion, atomic result/callback/effects and enabled lifecycle events. Confirmed output rollback records transport failure; domain retries remain separate. Uncertain completion reads exact permanent receipt/current owner; no automatic replay follows an unconfirmed outcome.
implementation.A1-A5: Detached bounded manual scheduled/async admission; request authority, live link and published registry gates rechecked on owner/job/event transaction. Concurrent key replay creates one owner/job/event; replay survives model changes. Bounded committed-state wait and explicit expected-generation redrive adapters. Ambiguous admission and post-admission wait errors retain opaque execution IDs for reconciliation.
implementation.C1-C5: Narrow read-only evaluation ports and actual configuration/history/platform/custom-list read facades with matching scope and per-read authorization. NewTargetPreparer uses real reads rather than nil-embedded test facades. Source full repositories remain structurally compatible; runtime selector is unchanged.
implementation.async_semantics: Live scenario/iteration/rule reads are bounded batches, not per-scenario metadata queries. Registry gates are batched by used table. All item outputs persist atomically; the source final-item-only result envelope is preserved. Total fan-out and encoded output budgets are enforced. Historical data is not claimed to share a global snapshot.
implementation.optional_outbox: Prepared lifecycle events derive enabled/disabled behavior from the evaluator's actual publication setting. Enabled event/job insertion must commit with the owner transition; disabled publication intentionally creates neither.
implementation.durable_requests: Stored-record requests preserve omitted field maps rather than persisting normalized managed fields as incoming payloads. Canonical detached requests contain no private prepared authority.

verification.compile_only: passed: go test -mod=readonly -p 2 -run '^$' ./...; not whole-module behavioral acceptance
verification.vet: passed: internal/ports, internal/service, internal/mysqlapi, internal/mysqlexecution, internal/store/mysql and internal/runtime/ast_eval
cases: Actual scheduled claim/start, whole-batch decisions/evidence/effect jobs and lifecycle event, repeated completion rejection and exact receipt reconciliation after delivery retention
Cancellation during model preparation leaves no decisions; invalid second input produces no partial batch and a redacted terminal failure
Injected required outbox failure rolls back all outputs; subsequent transport retry creates no duplicate decisions and consumes no new domain attempt
Actual shared poller completes work and joins on cancellation
Async explicit/new-live selection and multi-scenario fan-out, empty live selection, source final-item result shape and required callback insertion
Injected required callback insertion failure rolls back decisions, result and effect jobs; transport retry succeeds without duplication
Cross-kind transport, wrong preparer, foreign tenant/generation and revoked claim/read authority fail closed
Scheduled/async actual admission, candidate limits, invalid callback syntax and empty async rejection
Changed publication, closed registry and revoked final authority reject stale admission without owner/job writes
Injected queued lifecycle event failure rolls back owner/jobs; concurrent same-key submissions produce one owner/job/event
Authorized replay after model closure requires no new provider read, job or queued event
Bounded waiting distinguishes completed, failed, cancelled, timeout, first-read error and caller cancellation; no transaction is held while waiting
Strict redrive preconditions reject omitted/NULL/duplicate/negative/trailing values; callback redrive preserves terminal evaluation and rejects stale/foreign/revoked scope
Actual platform/list read values, exact spaced object IDs, risk absence, foreign tenant and revoked read errors
Missing/foreign reader scope and unsupported/duplicate aggregate policy fail target construction
Pure uncertain-commit/rollback decision branches and opaque admission reconciliation identity; this is not a full wire-level lost-COMMIT fault rehearsal
Raw request cloning rejects cyclic material, preserves stored-read omission and removes private preparation authority
verification.fixture_correction: The first new worker fixture attempted to regress an already-started owner counter and was rejected by the existing SQL trigger. The fixture was corrected to create a genuinely pending owner/job. Production monotonicity guards were not weakened.
verification.source_manifest: Explicit isolated PostgreSQL refresh reviewed. Two new production source-file entries and changed source hashes only; source catalog and target mappings unchanged. Source inventory contains 164 files.

environment.fixture_authority: Explicit test-only authorizers and data-model publication registry fixture; not an implementation of real foreign providers.
